+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import pandas as pd
+
+
+OUT = Path("out")
+OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+DB = duckdb.connect()
+DATA = "data/crashes.parquet"
+
+base = DB.execute(
+    """
+    SELECT
+      CASE WHEN EXTRACT(hour FROM crash_time) >= 20
+             OR EXTRACT(hour FROM crash_time) < 6 THEN 'Night' ELSE 'Day' END AS period,
+      COUNT(*) AS crashes,
+      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(number_of_persons_injured, 0) > 0
+                         OR COALESCE(number_of_persons_killed, 0) > 0) AS casualty_crashes,
+      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(number_of_persons_killed, 0) > 0) AS fatal_crashes,
+      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(number_of_pedestrians_injured, 0) > 0
+                         OR COALESCE(number_of_pedestrians_killed, 0) > 0) AS pedestrian_casualty_crashes,
+      SUM(COALESCE(number_of_pedestrians_injured, 0)) AS pedestrian_injuries,
+      SUM(COALESCE(number_of_pedestrians_killed, 0)) AS pedestrian_deaths
+    FROM read_parquet(?)
+    WHERE crash_time IS NOT NULL
+    GROUP BY period
+    ORDER BY CASE period WHEN 'Day' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
+    """,
+    [DATA],
+).fetchdf()
+
+dates = DB.execute(
+    "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT crash_date) AS days, MIN(crash_date) AS first_date, MAX(crash_date) AS last_date FROM read_parquet(?)",
+    [DATA],
+).fetchdf().iloc[0]
+days = int(dates["days"])
+
+# Option 1: recorded crash frequency, standardized to one clock-hour in each period.
+hours_by_period = {"Day": 14, "Night": 10}
+freq = base[["period", "crashes"]].copy()
+freq["calendar_days"] = days
+freq["hours_per_daypart"] = freq["period"].map(hours_by_period)
+freq["observed_clock_hours"] = freq["calendar_days"] * freq["hours_per_daypart"]
+freq["crashes_per_clock_hour"] = freq["crashes"] / freq["observed_clock_hours"]
+freq.to_csv(OUT / "values_1.csv", index=False)
+
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
+bars = ax.bar(freq["period"], freq["crashes_per_clock_hour"], color=["#4779a8", "#d47a43"], width=0.58)
+ax.set_title("Recorded NYC crashes per clock-hour", loc="left", fontsize=15, weight="bold")
+ax.set_subtitle if False else None
+ax.set_ylabel("Crashes per clock-hour across the dataset period")
+ax.set_xlabel("Day: 6 a.m.–7:59 p.m.  |  Night: 8 p.m.–5:59 a.m.")
+ax.bar_label(bars, fmt="%.1f", padding=4, fontsize=11)
+ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.2)
+fig.text(0.01, 0.01, f"{dates['first_date']}–{dates['last_date']}; standardized by 14 daytime vs. 10 nighttime hours per calendar day. Crash frequency is not individual risk.", fontsize=8)
+fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0.06, 1, 1))
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_1.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
+plt.close(fig)
+
+# Option 2: how often a reported crash involved harm, conditional on a crash.
+severity = base[["period", "crashes", "casualty_crashes", "fatal_crashes"]].copy()
+severity["casualty_crashes_per_1000"] = severity["casualty_crashes"] / severity["crashes"] * 1000
+severity["fatal_crashes_per_1000"] = severity["fatal_crashes"] / severity["crashes"] * 1000
+severity.to_csv(OUT / "values_2.csv", index=False)
+
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
+idx = range(len(severity))
+width = 0.34
+b1 = ax.bar([i - width / 2 for i in idx], severity["casualty_crashes_per_1000"], width,
+            label="Any person injured or killed", color="#4779a8")
+b2 = ax.bar([i + width / 2 for i in idx], severity["fatal_crashes_per_1000"], width,
+            label="At least one person killed", color="#d47a43")
+ax.set_xticks(list(idx), severity["period"])
+ax.set_title("Night crashes more often involve casualties", loc="left", fontsize=15, weight="bold")
+ax.set_ylabel("Crashes per 1,000 police-reported crashes")
+ax.set_xlabel("Day: 6 a.m.–7:59 p.m.  |  Night: 8 p.m.–5:59 a.m.")
+ax.bar_label(b1, fmt="%.1f", padding=3, fontsize=9)
+ax.bar_label(b2, fmt="%.2f", padding=3, fontsize=9)
+ax.legend(frameon=False, loc="upper left")
+ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.2)
+fig.text(0.01, 0.01, f"{dates['first_date']}–{dates['last_date']}; rates are conditional on a reported crash, not on time spent on the street.", fontsize=8)
+fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0.06, 1, 1))
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_2.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
+plt.close(fig)
+
+# Option 3: pedestrian-specific casualty involvement per reported crash.
+ped = base[["period", "crashes", "pedestrian_casualty_crashes", "pedestrian_injuries", "pedestrian_deaths"]].copy()
+ped["pedestrian_casualty_crashes_per_1000"] = ped["pedestrian_casualty_crashes"] / ped["crashes"] * 1000
+ped.to_csv(OUT / "values_3.csv", index=False)
+
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
+bars = ax.bar(ped["period"], ped["pedestrian_casualty_crashes_per_1000"], color=["#4779a8", "#d47a43"], width=0.58)
+ax.set_title("Pedestrian-casualty crashes per 1,000 reports", loc="left", fontsize=15, weight="bold")
+ax.set_ylabel("Crashes involving a pedestrian casualty per 1,000 crashes")
+ax.set_xlabel("Day: 6 a.m.–7:59 p.m.  |  Night: 8 p.m.–5:59 a.m.")
+ax.bar_label(bars, fmt="%.1f", padding=4, fontsize=11)
+ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.2)
+fig.text(0.01, 0.01, f"{dates['first_date']}–{dates['last_date']}; pedestrian injuries/deaths per crash, not per pedestrian trip or hour walked.", fontsize=8)
+fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0.06, 1, 1))
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_3.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
+plt.close(fig)
+
+print("Date range:", dates["first_date"], "to", dates["last_date"], "calendar dates:", days)
+print("\nOption 1\n", freq.to_string(index=False))
+print("\nOption 2\n", severity.to_string(index=False))
+print("\nOption 3\n", ped.to_string(index=False))
*** End Patch
